usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove a prepared auto-installer answer configuration that is no longer needed. Requires the System.Modify privilege on the system/auto-installation ACL path. This operation returns null synchronously — there is no UPID or async task to poll; deletion is immediate.

examples.summary: Delete a prepared auto-install configuration by ID

destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the prepared answer configuration; any automated installation workflow referencing this ID will fail until a replacement configuration is created.
tips: The id must be between 3 and 64 characters; verify the exact ID first using the list or get endpoint before deleting.
Deletion is immediate and irreversible — export or document the configuration before removing it if there is any chance it will be needed again.
API tokens are supported (allowtoken: true), so this can be safely scripted with a scoped token rather than user credentials.
